test_javascript_tokenizer_discarding_com: test the JavascriptProcessor tokenizer to verify it correctly discards comments from JavaScript source code
test_javascript_detokenizer_discarding_c: test the JavascriptProcessor detokenizer to verify round-trip tokenization and detokenization discards comments
test_javascript_tokenizer_keeping_commen: test the JavascriptProcessor tokenizer with keep_comments enabled to preserve comment tokens in output
test_javascript_detokenizer_keeping_comm: test the JavascriptProcessor detokenizer with keep_comments enabled to verify round-trip preserves comment tokens
test_detokenize_invertible: test that detokenizing tokenized JavaScript code produces equivalent source code when stripped of whitespace
